Name: The Crew
Description: Turge, Lobrick, Hillary, Skid, Hognath, Sasa, Hammock, Rocks, Hidebehind, Sam Cobb, Tuille, Pit, Covey, Scarr, Rum, and, of course, The Rockrose herself.

Innate.Name: Captain's Orders
Innate.Description: At the start of each round, you can issue one of the orders of your Captain's Hat. The effects of the order last until the end of the round, when you must issue a new order. When you issue the Retreat! order using this feature, you and any number of allies you can see teleport to any unoccupied space you can see.

Actions.Name: Crunge & Turge
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, Turge leaps into action alongside you. You can take an additional action this turn.

Actions.Name: Crew Specialty
Actions.Description:
When you take this Hero Action, raise your Crew Counter by 1, then activate one of the Crew Specialties listed below. Then, if the Specialty activated is different from the one you activated last turn, raise the Crew Counter again. 

 Hillary's Hustle
	Hop to it, and quick! Your allies gain X times 5 feet of movement speed on their next turn.

Hognath's Barrage
	Ready, aim… MORE POWDER. All enemies take Xd10 bludgeoning and Xd10 fire damage.

Skid's Remedy
	Don't whine, it's good for you. All allies heal 2*Xd6 hit points.
